g.text: PR #2401 · Preserve Codex timing, answer phases and original import dates
Keep original event clocks for display; keep server ingestion clocks for replay and retention.
Typed item metadata retains durations and phase without duplicating the full payload.
BEFORE
AFTER
Exec normalization drops timing and phase
Agent commentary looks like a final answer.
Command, MCP and reasoning cards have no duration.
ThreadWithMetadata keeps typed display details
Commentary muted; partial/final answers stay normal.
Completed tool work shows a valid elapsed duration.
Imports show the date of the copy
Original native timestamps never reach the row.
Source record dates are replaced by import time.
source_created_at is a separate nullable column
PortalMeta carries the original display clock.
created_at remains server ingestion and replay.
Restores overload one clock in two ways
Old created_at can expire a freshly restored row.
Tied NOW() values can scramble random-UUID order.
NewHistoricalMessage keeps both clocks
Fresh ordered ingestion times keep replay stable.
Archive and restore preserve the original date.
Original time can be older than the retention window.
display_at_iso prefers source; raw_iso stays server.
Missing source clocks remain explicitly unknown.
Real DB tests cover order, retention and archives.
Scope: legacy senders without original clocks display server time; existing imported records are not backfilled.
